title: Zesty Smoky Turkish Beef Kebabs
description: Sour and smoky kebabs made with tender hind shank, finished char-grilled, keto-friendly, and packed with zesty yogurt sauce.
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
In a bowl, whisk together yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Toss beef cubes in the yogurt mixture, cover, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a charcoal grill or grill pan to high heat and oil the grates with olive oil.
Thread marinated beef onto soaked skewers, leaving small gaps between cubes.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, turning once, until the meat is char-grilled and juices run clear.
Brush the kebabs with remaining yogurt sauce during the last minute of grilling for extra moisture.
Remove from grill, let rest for 5 minutes, then serve hot with a side of fresh parsley and a wedge of lemon.
Enjoy the zesty, smoky flavors of this keto-friendly Turkish delight.
